Coram : S.B. SINHA*, CYRIAC JOSEPH
<j Kera/a Abkari Shops (Disposal in Auction) Rules, 1974: JI( r. 6(30)- Mixing of 'diazepam' in toddy- Held: Constitutes an offence - Licence liable to cancellation under r. 6(30) - c Kera/a Abkari Act - ss.57(a), 56. rr.6(28), 6(30) - Cancellation of licence under Rule 6(30) - Forfeiture of follow. ,--t Kera/a Revenue Recovery Act: s. 7 - Demand for loss D incurred by Government in holding re-auction on cancellation of licence - Loss purportedly sustained by the State as if the privilege of sale in toddy was transferred for three years - Held: Licence was granted for one
